Subject: SummitBank pre-audit evidence intake and timeline

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for taking a call this morning. We're kicking off pre-audit intake for our vendor review (ISO 27001 scoping + FedRAMP preparation). A couple quick asks so we can line up our audit calendar with internal scheduling: 

- Can you confirm a proposed snapshot/sampling window for evidence (we're targeting mid-Oct but flexible).
- Do you have a short runbook that lists control owners, artifact examples, and evidence formats? Auditors prefer zipped bundles with a manifest.
- Any blackouts (maintenance windows) we should avoid when requesting logs/snapshots?

If you can share a runbook and a short timeline by end of day Thursday 10/7, that would help us lock the review with procurement and security ops.

Appreciate it — I can loop in our external auditor if needed.

Best,

> Proposed approach:
> - Snapshot window: 2027-10-15 to 2027-10-22 (7 days)...

Thanks — a few practical notes from infra/observability side: 

- We can produce zipped artifact bundles per control owner with a standard manifest (SHA256 checksums). Use the sample-artifacts-list as the canonical manifest template.
- Logs: we can export application and inference runtime logs at 1-hour rollups and raw events for a 7-day period; raw event export will be large (~30GB) — confirm whether auditors want full raw exports or filtered extracts.
- Snapshots: we'll capture KV-cache metrics and model-serving config at snapshot time; if auditors want historical cache-level data, we need 72-hour notice per model to enable retention beyond default TTL.
- Retention SLA: by default we keep 90 days of raw logs; we can extend to 1 year for specific buckets if procurement approves (this is a cost delta).

Action items I can take: prepare manifest template and a small example zip for Emily by Tue 10/05 EOD; provision read-only S3 links for auditor if confirmed.

-David
